laws.rule: Parque Nacional Radal Siete Tazas: The page reports reopening from 26 September 2026 except the long-distance El Bolsón, Valle del Indio and Laguna de las Ánimas trails. El Bolsón also has a closure-until-further-notice notice from 28 May 2026. Do not treat the general reopening as permission for those routes. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.

items.text: Parque Nacional Radal Siete Tazas: CONAF's own unit page prohibits consuming alcoholic drinks. This is the named protected-area condition, not an alcohol ban throughout the region.

Parque Nacional Radal Siete Tazas: smoking is prohibited in CONAF's published unit conditions. The same page prohibits consuming drugs or hallucinogenic products; no wider possession or prescribing rule is inferred.
